en: Target located. This must be the broken{SAUT}robot.
Let's see, it's missing a component,{SAUT}right? I wonder which one...
I will take a look. Please wait a moment.

Okay, so that's all we need? Let's get to{SAUT}it, then!
This sounds like a job for Koromaru.
Koromaru-san is indeed very{SAUT}motivated. He says his strong sense of{SAUT}smell will aid us in our search.

Now, wait just a minute! I've got a pretty{SAUT}good sense of smell myself, you know!{PAGE}Witness the power of my all-smelling{SAUT}nose! Let's see...*sniff sniff*{PAGE}...Ah, this scent! It's coming from{SAUT}Yosuke's pocket!
Hey! That's my gum, you idiot!{PAGE}Look, just sit down and let Koromaru{SAUT}handle it!
He wishes for us to follow him. It seems{SAUT}he's picked up the scent.
Way to go, Koromaru! We can always{SAUT}count on you!
